description: This file defines an adapter for a RecyclerView in an Android application, specifically for displaying a list of leave records. It handles creating view holders, binding leave data to views, and managing differences between list items for efficient updates.

classes.name: LeaveListAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of leave entries with click handling.

classes.name: LeaveViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for managing individual leave item views.

classes.name: LeaveDiffCallback
classes.description: A DiffUtil callback class for calculating differences between leave list items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ViewHolder for a leave item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds leave data to the given ViewHolder.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Populates the view elements with data from a Leave object.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two leave items represent the same item based on id.

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two leave items have the same content.
